graph_basis.identity: For a CNF F with clause-variable incidence graph I(F), delta*(F)=|Clauses(F)|-nu(I(F)), where nu is maximum matching size.
graph_basis.source_lineage: Hall/matching characterization used by Szeider maximum-deficiency theory.

operation.name: BALANCED_ODD_EDGE_SUBDIVISION
operation.definition: For any chosen incidence edge c--v, replace it by an alternating path c--y1--d1--y2--d2--...--yt--dt--v, adding exactly t new variable-side vertices y_i and t new clause-side vertices d_i. Different original edges may be subdivided independently, with arbitrary finite t_e>=0.

theorem.statement: If I' is obtained from bipartite incidence graph I by balanced odd subdivision of any set of edges, then nu(I')=nu(I)+sum_e t_e. Consequently clause-side matching deficiency and CNF maximum deficiency are invariant.
lower_bound_proof: Start with a maximum matching M of I.
For each subdivided edge e=c--v with t=t_e: if e is not used by M, keep all old matching edges and match each new clause d_i to a private adjacent new variable y_i, adding t matches.
If e is used by M, replace the old matched edge c--v by a perfect matching of the subdivided path, of size t+1, again increasing the matching size by exactly t.
The interiors of distinct subdivided edges are disjoint, so these replacements are compatible. Hence nu(I')>=nu(I)+sum t_e.
upper_bound_proof: By Konig's theorem, let K be a minimum vertex cover of I of size nu(I).
For each subdivided original edge, K contains at least one of its endpoints c or v.
An odd path replacing that edge can be covered by the already-selected endpoint(s) plus exactly t internal vertices, chosen alternately along the path.
Doing this independently for all subdivided edges produces a vertex cover K' of I' of size |K|+sum t_e.
Konig's theorem gives nu(I')<=|K'|=nu(I)+sum t_e, proving equality.
theorem.maxdef_corollary: The operation adds sum t_e clause vertices and the same number of matching edges at optimum, so |C'|-nu(I')=|C|-nu(I); therefore delta* is unchanged.

R44BD_effect.meaning: Any auxiliary construction whose incidence-level effect is only to replace existing clause-variable edges by balanced alternating clone/link chains cannot lower maximum deficiency.
contains: R44BG one-occurrence variable splitting as the t=1 case on every selected incidence edge
arbitrary finite chains of occurrence copies and link clauses
R44BD_effect.selector_debt: Applying such subdivisions to R44BE selector guarding cannot repair its additive maxdef debt.

scope.not_covered: Gadgets that add non-path shared constraints, branch-cross-couplings, or new incidence topology rather than balanced subdivisions.
scope.authority: Pure graph/matching theorem; no heuristic or benchmark dependency.
